versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Haven Media (x402): pay-per-call media generation with USDC via the x402 protocol—no signup or API key required.
- Supports generating music, images (creation, editing, upscaling, restoring), and video (with or without synchronized audio).
- Compatible with the Haven MCP server for automated payment flow, job tracking, and spend caps, or your own x402 v2 client.
- Media jobs are priced per call, with moderation and content screening on every input and output before any charge.
- Jobs are only charged on delivery; results are retained for 7 days.
- Use of video outputs is subject to specific licensing terms disclosed at purchase.
